Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 자칭 초천재 엘리트 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(이)가 이제부터 진짜 실력을 보여준다고 한다. 뭐라고 얘기할까?
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: The self-proclaimed super genius elite <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> claims she's ready to show me her true power. What should I say?
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 自称超天才エリート<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>がこれから本物の実力を見せつけるそうだ。何て言うべきだろう？
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 自称超级天才精英的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>说要从现在开始展现真正的实力。该说什么好呢？
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 自稱超級天才精英的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>說要從現在開始展現真正的實力。該說什麼好呢？
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: La super génie élite autoproclamée <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> affirme qu'elle va vous montrer sa vraie puissance. Que devrais-je dire ?
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Die selbsternannte supergeniale Elite <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> behauptet, sie werde ab jetzt ihre wahre Stärke zeigen. Was soll ich sagen?
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: La autoproclamada supergenio de élite, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, dice que está lista para mostrarme su verdadero poder. ¿Qué debería decir?
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: A autoproclamada "supergênio de elite" <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> diz que vai me mostrar seu verdadeiro poder agora. O que devo dizer?
Data.UnitTalk_THA: "อัจฉริยะขั้นเทพ" <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ที่เรียกตัวเองแบบนั้น บอกว่าจะแสดงฝีมือที่แท้จริงให้ดูแล้ว จะพูดว่าอะไรดีนะ?
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Si jenius super elite yang memproklamirkan diri, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, bilang dia siap menunjukkan kekuatan aslinya. Apa yang harus kukatakan?
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Thiên tài siêu việt tự xưng <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> nói rằng cô ấy sẽ thể hiện thực lực thật sự từ bây giờ. Tôi nên nói gì đây?
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: स्वघोषित सुपर जीनियस एलीट <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> का दावा है कि वह अब अपनी असली शक्ति दिखाने के लिए तैयार है। मुझे क्या कहना चाहिए?

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: No, the mission now is to rest at full strength!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: いや、戻って全力で休むんだ！
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Non, il faut rentrer et se reposer à fond !
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Nein, wir gehen zurück und ruhen uns mit voller Kraft aus!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: ¡No, la misión ahora es descansar con todas las fuerzas!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Não, a missão agora é descansar com força total!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ไม่สิ ต้องกลับไปพักผ่อนให้เต็มที่ต่างหาก!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Không, bây giờ là lúc quay về nghỉ ngơi thật sung sức!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: नहीं, वापस जाकर पूरी ताकत से आराम करना है!

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: All right then, let's go all out!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Na gut, dann geben wir alles!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Tudo bem, então, vamos com tudo!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ดีเลย ไปกันอย่างเต็มที่เลยค่ะ!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Baiklah, kalau begitu, ayo kita lakukan dengan sekuat tenaga!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Được thôi, hãy dốc toàn lực nào!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: ठीक है, तो चलो पूरी ताकत से चलते हैं!

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 活力ポーションを渡す。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ยื่นยาโพชั่นพลังชีวิตให้
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Đưa một bình Thuốc Sinh Lực.

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decided to stop training and rest.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>はトレーニングをここまでにし、休むことにした。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a décidé d'arrêter l'entraînement et de se reposer.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> beschloss, das Training zu beenden und sich auszuruhen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decidió dejar el entrenamiento y descansar.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decidiu parar o treino e descansar.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ตัดสินใจหยุดฝึกและพักผ่อน
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> memutuskan untuk berhenti berlatih dan beristirahat.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã quyết định nghỉ ngơi sau khi hoàn thành khóa huấn luyện.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने प्रशिक्षण बंद करने और आराम करने का फैसला किया।

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 휴식하기로 했지만 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 아쉬움이 남아있는 것 같다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Though she decided to rest, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> still seemed unsatisfied.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 休むことにしたが、<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、物足りなさを感じているようだ。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 虽然决定休息，但<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎还有些遗憾。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 雖然決定休息，但<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎還有些遺憾。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Bien qu'elle ait décidé de se reposer, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> semblait toujours insatisfaite.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Obwohl sie sich zum Ausruhen entschloss, schien <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> immer noch unzufrieden zu sein.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Embora tenha decidido descansar, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ainda parecia insatisfeita.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: แม้จะตัดสินใจพักผ่อนแล้ว แต่ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ก็ยังดูไม่พอใจเท่าไรนัก
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Meskipun dia memutuskan untuk beristirahat, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> masih terlihat tidak puas.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Dù đã quyết định nghỉ ngơi, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vẫn có vẻ không hài lòng.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: हालांकि उसने आराम करने का फैसला किया, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> अभी भी असंतुष्ट लग रही थी।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tried again and achieved solid results.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は再度トレーニングに挑戦し、成果を上げた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>再度挑战训练并取得了成果。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>再度挑戰訓練並取得了成果。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a réessayé et a obtenu des résultats solides.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> versuchte es erneut und erzielte solide Ergebnisse.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> lo intentó de nuevo y obtuvo resultados sólidos.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tentou novamente e obteve resultados sólidos.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ได้ท้าทายการฝึกอีกครั้งและได้รับผลลัพธ์ที่ดี
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> kembali menantang latihan dan mencapai hasil yang solid.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> thử lại và đạt được kết quả khả quan.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने फिर से कोशिश की और ठोस परिणाम प्राप्त किए।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tried again but failed once more.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は再度トレーニングに挑戦したが、失敗した。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a réessayé mais a échoué une fois de plus.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> versuchte es erneut, scheiterte aber wieder.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> lo intentó de nuevo, pero volvió a fallar.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tentou o treino novamente, mas falhou.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> พยายามฝึกอีกครั้ง แต่ก็ล้มเหลว
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> kembali menantang latihan tetapi gagal sekali lagi.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> thử lại nhưng thất bại một lần nữa.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने फिर से कोशिश की लेकिन एक बार फिर असफल रही।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> brightened up after receiving the potion.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、ポーションを受け取って喜んだ。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> s'est égayée après avoir reçu la potion.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> freute sich über den erhaltenen Trank.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animó después de recibir la poción.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animou depois de receber a poção.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ได้รับยาและดีใจ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> menjadi ceria setelah menerima ramuan itu.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vui vẻ hẳn lên sau khi nhận được bình thuốc.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: औषधि मिलने के बाद <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> खुश हो गई।
